name: skills
description: punkaze's agent skills collection. Ships bruno (author, generate, and run Bruno .bru API collections), hetzner-server-provision (provision a hardened, key-only Hetzner Cloud server end-to-end via the hcloud CLI), worktree-setup (config-driven git worktree setup with single/dual-repo scope splitting), free-disk-space (find reclaimable disk space on macOS/Linux and hand over copy-paste cleanup commands, read-only and never deletes on its own), tracking-test-cases (a persistent, branch-scoped pre-PR manual QA checklist that diffs each run against the last one and survives worktree deletion after merge), and shelf-issue (capture an in-flight bug as a resumable known-issue doc, preview the whole corpus as a sortable/filterable local HTML dashboard, and safely bulk-retrofit many docs at once).
